attempts.text: [{"name": "v2b_pair", "idea": "History view-to-purchase strength from the session's last 10 distinct prefix items to every candidate via tb_view2buy, weighted 10..1 by recency, plus the smoothed order share of those links, to lift cart and order items that browsing leads to.", "kind": "feature", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH p AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions x ON s.session = x.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), pr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS r FROM p), pt AS (SELECT session, item, r FROM pr WHERE r <= 10), sc AS (SELECT c.session, c.item, sum(CAST(t.tv_cnt AS BIGINT) * (11 - pt.r)) AS v, sum(CAST(t.tv_cnt AS BIGINT)) AS n, sum(CAST(t.tv_ord AS BIGINT)) AS o FROM cand c JOIN pt ON pt.session = c.session AND pt.item <> c.item JOIN tb_view2buy t ON t.item = pt.item AND t.item2 = c.item GROUP BY c.session, c.item) SELECT session, item, CAST(v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_v2b_score, CAST((o + 0.5) / (n + 2.0) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_v2b_ord_share FROM sc;"}, {"name": "wk_cobuy_all", "idea": "In-week co-buy share for all candidates including base ones: for the last 5 distinct prefix items, the share of other recent target-week prefixes containing them that carted or ordered the candidate (own prefix removed), recency weighted, plus the order count.", "kind": "feature", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH l AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions b ON s.session = b.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), lr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS r FROM l), lt AS (SELECT session, item, r FROM lr WHERE r <= 5), it AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM lt), bt AS (SELECT session, item, max(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS o FROM sess WHERE event IN ('cart', 'order') GROUP BY session, item), ps0 AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.ts) AS mt FROM sess s JOIN it ON s.item = it.item GROUP BY s.session, s.item), ps AS (SELECT session, item FROM (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY item ORDER BY mt DESC, session) AS rn FROM ps0) z WHERE rn <= 1000), nn AS (SELECT item, count(*) AS n FROM ps GROUP BY item), nx AS (SELECT p.item AS item, b.item AS item2, count(*) AS nb, sum(b.o) AS nord FROM ps p JOIN bt b ON b.session = p.session AND b.item <> p.item GROUP BY p.item, b.item), z0 AS (SELECT c.session, c.item, lt.r, nn.n, nx.nb - CASE WHEN ob.item IS NOT NULL AND op.item IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS nb, nx.nord - CASE WHEN ob.item IS NOT NULL AND op.item IS NOT NULL THEN ob.o ELSE 0 END AS nord FROM cand c JOIN lt ON lt.session = c.session AND lt.item <> c.item JOIN nx ON nx.item = lt.item AND nx.item2 = c.item JOIN nn ON nn.item = lt.item LEFT JOIN bt ob ON ob.session = c.session AND ob.item = c.item LEFT JOIN ps op ON op.session = c.session AND op.item = lt.item), sc AS (SELECT session, item, sum((nb * 100000) // (n + 5) * (6 - r)) AS v, sum(nord * (6 - r)) AS vo FROM z0 WHERE nb > 0 GROUP BY session, item) SELECT session, item, CAST(v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_wcb_share, CAST(vo AS DOUBLE) AS ag_wcb_ord FROM sc WHERE v > 0;"}, {"name": "nv_last_share", "idea": "Normalized history next-view probability from the very last prefix item to the candidate (its transition weight divided by the total outgoing weight of that item), a sharper signal for the first viewed item after the cut.", "kind": "feature", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH e AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.session ORDER BY s.seq DESC, s.item) AS rk FROM sess s JOIN sessions b ON s.session = b.session), li AS (SELECT session, item FROM e WHERE rk = 1), tw AS (SELECT t.item, t.item2, CAST(round(t.tv_wgt * 6) AS BIGINT) AS w FROM tb_nextview t JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM li) u ON u.item = t.item), tt AS (SELECT item, sum(w) AS tot FROM tw GROUP BY item) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(tw.w * 1.0 / tt.tot AS DOUBLE) AS ag_nv1_share FROM cand c JOIN li ON li.session = c.session JOIN tw ON tw.item = li.item AND tw.item2 = c.item JOIN tt ON tt.item = li.item WHERE tt.tot > 0;"}, {"name": "i_buy_momentum", "idea": "Purchase momentum of each item: smoothed share of its 7-day history buying sessions that fall in the last day before the week, and in-week buying prefixes relative to those 7-day history buying sessions, to catch items whose sales are rising now.", "kind": "feature", "level": "item", "sql": "WITH h AS (SELECT item, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ts >= {S} - 86400 THEN session END) AS c1, count(DISTINCT session) AS c7 FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 7*86400 AND event IN ('cart', 'order') GROUP BY item), w AS (SELECT item, count(DISTINCT session) AS wc FROM sess WHERE event IN ('cart', 'order') GROUP BY item), u AS (SELECT item FROM h UNION SELECT item FROM w) SELECT u.item, CAST((coalesce(h.c1, 0) + 1.0) / (coalesce(h.c7, 0) + 7.0) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_i_buy_mom, CAST((coalesce(w.wc, 0) + 1.0) / (coalesce(h.c7, 0) + 5.0) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_i_wk_buy_trend FROM u LEFT JOIN h ON h.item = u.item LEFT JOIN w ON w.item = u.item;"}, {"name": "p_span_rel", "idea": "Temporal shape of each prefix item: seconds between its first and last occurrence (sustained interest) and its last-occurrence age relative to the session duration, which normalizes recency across fast and slow sessions.", "kind": "feature", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH e AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, s.ts FROM sess s JOIN sessions b ON s.session = b.session), m AS (SELECT session, max(ts) AS mt, min(ts) AS ft FROM e GROUP BY session), g AS (SELECT session, item, min(ts) AS f, max(ts) AS l FROM e GROUP BY session, item) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(g.l - g.f AS DOUBLE) AS ag_p_span, CAST((m.mt - g.l) * 1.0 / (m.mt - m.ft + 60) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_p_age_rel FROM cand c JOIN g ON g.session = c.session AND g.item = c.item JOIN m ON m.session = c.session;"}]
